newsitem.title: CANADA: Alcan hopes for Kemano deal in two months.
newsitem.headline: Alcan hopes for Kemano deal in two months.

text.p: Alcan Aluminium Ltd said Thursday that it hopes to reach a settlement with British Columbia on compensation for its cancelled Kemano hydroelectric project within two months.

Alcan chief executive Jacques Bougie met B.C. Premier Glen Clark earlier this week and the two "instructed their negotiators to intensify their efforts over the next seven to eight weeks and try to get a negotiated settlement," Alcan spokesman Ray Castelli said.
Talks had broken off earlier this year and Alcan filed a legal action to protect its right to sue.
